steps.title: Name your game
steps.text: Its name is in the project’s settings. The title screen and an exported game show it.

steps.title: Rewrite the keeper’s log
steps.text: The logbook is an ink scene. Its last choice sets the flag the lamp waits for.

steps.title: Change what lighting the lamp takes
steps.text: Each stage is what the journal says, what must be done, and where its marker points.

steps.title: Put something else in the chest
steps.text: The keeper’s room opens at the chest. What it holds is on its Interact.

steps.title: Change what opens the store
steps.text: The store door opens only when its When holds. Make it need something else.

steps.title: Build on the rock
steps.text: The rock opens in the Scene panel. Add starter kit pieces, or move the landing.

steps.title: Change the night
steps.text: The hour, the sky and the fog are the night’s environment.

steps.title: Recolour it
steps.text: Six colours, a typeface and a size are the whole theme.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Play it in the Play panel, then export it from the Project panel.
